implementation.precision: original BF16 all 16 bits; FP32 activation and arithmetic
implementation.retained_weights: Keep the existing private Shared buffers and memory budget.
implementation.unretained_one_token_projections: Borrow a page-aligned read-only archive range with a temporary newBufferWithBytesNoCopy view; wait for GPU completion before releasing it.
implementation.prefill: Multi-token projections keep original BF16 staging. Startup retention keeps pread into Shared buffers.
implementation.fallback: If a mapped view cannot be created, read the prepared range into the existing staging buffer. Missing/incompatible cache ranges use the original reader.
implementation.memory: One borrowed GPU view is at most the existing staging window (64 MiB). Reclaimable OS file pages are outside the private retained-weight budget and may increase total RAM usage.

prepared_archive.placement: Hard-linked the existing verified archive into the API model directory; no second 12.3 GB copy.

paired_decode.text: Translation quality depends on context, terminology, and the structure of the original document. A useful system should preserve numbers, dates, and product names while producing natural sentences. This benchmark compares the same full precision model on the CPU and the GPU. It measures the delay before the first output token and the time spent generating subsequent tokens, while checking the translated text and the numerical differences between the two implementations.

paired_decode.method: Alternating before/after workers; one two-token warmup then one measured request each. Decode time excludes startup and prefill. Medians include only pairs with equal retained weights/storage at ready, after warmup and after the measured request.
paired_decode.limits: OS caching and background memory pressure are uncontrolled. A saved baseline worker is required; the same benchmark-only memory cap must be used for both workers when specified. I/O bytes count explicit pread only. Mapped bytes count borrowed file ranges, not physical disk reads or current residency; mapped file pages are reclaimable OS storage outside the private weight budget.

metal_io.note: Two rotating-order scans of 64 actual packed chunks (2.91 GB per pass). MTLIO did not improve upon pread64; same checksums.

kernels.note: Real 64 MiB GU/down windows, columns 4096/16384. Nibble specialization, fixed-shape loops and block-header hoisting had no consistent gain. All outputs bitwise equal. Production kernels unchanged.

limits: Decode throughput excludes loading and prompt processing; each worker receives one two-token warmup and then one measured request, limited to 12 generated tokens.
GPU private retained weights, storage format and staging budget match at ready, after warmup and after the measured request for all three pairs. This does not imply identical total OS RAM usage.

File cache state, page-in behavior, background memory pressure and other application activity are uncontrolled. This is a partial-retention measurement on one M2, not a fully resident or cold-cache claim.
Zero explicit pread bytes after the change does not mean zero physical disk I/O. Mapped-byte counters count logical archive ranges including repeats, not current residency or physical disk reads.
Maximum-token samples may be incomplete translations. Equality checks compare full-vector hashes and exact generated outputs within the measured lengths.
